en.body: A cloud-native analytics workflow that provisions BigQuery and storage with Terraform, ingests market data with Python, and tests warehouse models with dbt and GitHub Actions.
en.cta: Read the full story on the site and use GitHub as the operational proof point.

pt.body: Um workflow cloud-native de analytics que provisiona BigQuery e storage com Terraform, ingere dados de mercado com Python e testa modelos de warehouse com dbt e GitHub Actions.
pt.cta: Leia a historia completa no site e use o GitHub como prova operacional.
